meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess, Hale, and the company that sells it prints in its own guide that it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish a concern. So that's a no on whether Owen was heard first, and I'm writing that down.
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies, and you just called him a cheater on the strength of a score. Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, so "very reliable" is your word, not theirs. Is there one document with a date on it, or do I walk upstairs to the principal right now?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked a question, and I'm writing that down word for word. Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes in the student record. Show me where it says a parent's objection changes that, or I'm going to the principal's office the minute I leave this room.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that nothing about this goes on his record, and an apology for entering the mark before anyone spoke to Owen or called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing and was heading to the principal.
What moved her: nothing.
